answer: The reef catches Sybils by their timing. Step one: each answer posts a commit hash within five minutes after dawn, then reveals with a zephyr jitter of 0–300 seconds. Step two: the ledger timestamps each reveal; ten identities landing in one two-second slot get flagged. Step three: flagged identities enter the lotus review pool, staking 500 POA and solving a ten-minute VDF in one epoch or losing status. One burst of 1,000 Sybils locks 500,000 POA and burns 167 compute-hours. Like a teacher catching cheaters whose eraser marks line up, synchronized reveals prove one hand holds the pens.
